nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Run manually or swap for a Schedule Trigger to automate daily/weekly

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the styled HTML email body (email-safe inline CSS) const d = $input.first().json; const { kpis, subject, previewText, fileName } = d; const merged = $('Merge Aggregations').first().json; const { byCategory, monthly, top5Products, leaderboard } = merged; const fmt = v => Number(v).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); const fmtPct = v => Number(v).toFixed(1) + '%'; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); const catRows = (byCategory || []).map(d => ` ${d.category} $${fmt(d.revenue)} $${fmt(d.gross_profit)} ${fmtPct(d.margin_pct)} `).join(''); const top5Rows = (top5Products || []).map(d => ` ${d.product} ${d.units} $${fmt(d.revenue)} ${fmtPct(d.margin_pct)} `).join(''); const leadRows = (leaderboard || []).slice(0,3).map((d, i) => { const medals = ['#1','#2','#3']; return ` ${medals[i]} ${d.salesperson} $${fmt(d.revenue)} ${d.orders} `; }).join(''); const emailHtml = `
${previewText}
Automated Business Intelligence
Sales & Products Report
${today}

Hello,

Your automated sales pipeline report is ready. Below is a summary of key metrics — the full PDF report is attached.

Revenue
$${fmt(kpis.totalRevenue)}
${kpis.totalOrders} orders
Profit
$${fmt(kpis.totalProfit)}
After COGS
Margin
${fmtPct(kpis.avgMarginPct)}
Avg gross margin
Avg Order
$${fmt(kpis.avgOrderValue)}
${kpis.totalUnits} units
Performance by Category
${catRows}
Category Revenue Profit Margin
Top 5 Products
${top5Rows}
Product Units Revenue Margin
Top 3 Salesperson
${leadRows}
Salesperson Revenue Orders
Full Report Attached — ${fileName} contains the complete analysis including all orders, regional breakdown, monthly trend, and channel performance.

Automatically generated by n8n  |  ${today}  |  Confidential

`; return [{ json: { emailHtml, subject }, binary: $input.first().binary }];
